description: This source file defines the class `ArrayOrSingleItemHelper`, which provides methods to handle PDF dictionary keys that may contain either a single PDF item or an array of such items. It includes methods to add, retrieve, check for, and remove items of type `PdfItem` or its subclasses, with functionality to treat the items as either single or multiple objects.

classes.name: ArrayOrSingleItemHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing PDF dictionary keys that may store a single `PdfItem` or an array of such items, providing methods for adding, retrieving, checking, and removing items.

methods.name: ArrayOrSingleItemHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with the specified dictionary elements.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a `PdfItem` to the specified key, creating an array if necessary, and optionally prepending the item.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all `PdfItem`s associated with a specified key.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves filtered `PdfItem`s based on a predicate.

methods.name: Get<T>
methods.description: Retrieves `PdfItem`s of type `T` that match a predicate.

methods.name: Get<T>
methods.description: Retrieves `PdfItem`s of type `T` that are equal to a specified value.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a key contains an item of type `T` matching a predicate.

methods.name: Contains<T>
methods.description: Checks if a key contains an item of type `T` equal to a specified value.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes items matching a predicate from a key, adjusting array or single item as needed.

methods.name: Remove<T>
methods.description: Removes items of type `T` matching a predicate.

methods.name: Remove<T>
methods.description: Removes items of type `T` equal to a specified value.
